qualification: 72 Windows local fixture tests; real public GET-only preflight; extracted archive exercised by build.py. No public signing/login/mint/gameplay or browser-extension UI qualification.
preserved: Mint/calldata/reconcile function block and chat helper block byte-identical; provenance and all prior tests/licenses unchanged.
windows: Real held-open read/replace reproductions failed on baseline; 9 bounded local attempts, 50ms delays. No side-effect/SQLite retries.
tradeoffs: No distributed atomicity between server acceptance and encrypted local capture. Missing/partial/malformed evidence remains blocked.
Read-only refers to external effects: ack may write encrypted session and atomically finalize local login/nonce records.

Cookies preserve legacy dictionary semantics. Payload capture is after HTTP decompression, before JSON/text decoding. Header/cookie metadata limited to 64 KiB; oversize is truncated and nonrecoverable.
Expired-after-receipt acceptance may finalize consumed operation but cannot activate/extend expired session.
Same-user malware and concurrent unrelated wallet sends remain out of scope.
